name: GitHub
summary: Repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions and code search

auth.help: A personal access token. Give it only the repositories and permissions the agent needs.

riskNote: Can create pull requests, push files, merge, delete files and trigger Actions. Prefer a fine-grained token with read access first.

name: Stripe
summary: Customers, invoices, subscriptions, refunds and documentation search

auth.help: An agent API key with the smallest set of permissions. Use a sandbox account first.

riskNote: Moves money. Its write tool covers POST, PATCH, PUT and DELETE. Stripe asks for human confirmation on refunds and outbound payments.

name: Notion
summary: Search, read, create and update pages and databases

auth.help: A token made by a workspace owner under New MCP token in the developer portal. Business and Enterprise plans only; the sign-in flow cannot run without a person.

riskNote: Can edit and delete pages and databases.

name: Atlassian (Jira and Confluence)
summary: Jira work items, Confluence pages, Bitbucket

auth.help: Sign-in through the browser is the normal route. Atlassian lists API tokens as an option.

riskNote: Creates and updates work items and pages and posts comments.
unverifiedNote: The header an API token goes in is not documented, so this entry sends it as a bearer token. Check the Atlassian page before relying on it.

name: Cloudflare
summary: The Cloudflare API: DNS, Workers, rules and more

auth.help: A Cloudflare API token. Scope it to the accounts and zones the agent should touch.

riskNote: Can change DNS, Workers and rules, and create billable resources, depending on the token's scope.

name: Supabase
summary: Database, SQL, migrations, projects and branches
riskNote: Runs SQL and migrations and can create paid projects. The address starts read-only; add project_ref to limit it to one project. Table data can carry prompt injection, so never give it to end users.

name: Git
summary: Read, search and change local Git repositories

requires.help: Install uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) so the agent can start this server. It runs on your machine, in the folder you start the agent from.

riskNote: Can add, reset, commit and switch branches. Described by its authors as in early development.
